name: io.github.1QEXLE/qany
title: qany
description: Search the web without an API key. 13 public sources, fused ranking, page reading.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server on stdio

environmentVariables.name: QANY_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the page cache and the reading corpus

environmentVariables.name: QANY_NO_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the disk cache

environmentVariables.name: QANY_NO_LEARN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop recording pages in the local corpus
